title: Assess Dify for a bounded self-hosted LLM platform pilot

context.description: Assess whether a small engineering team should run a local Dify pilot for visual LLM workflows and retrieval applications. The current evidence is limited to public source files at one pinned revision; no Dify code or containers were executed.
constraints: Use only public evidence pinned to langgenius/dify revision ad90cb911138f6b27af996c87afe34fbb5a4ed16.
Do not run repository code, containers, migrations, plugins, or network-facing services during the evidence-only assessment.
Do not infer security, performance, production suitability, or license compatibility from upstream documentation.
Require manual review of modified-license conditions for the intended tenancy, branding, and distribution model.
Keep deployment or adoption blocked until a separate sandboxed local pilot and operational review produce runtime evidence.

evidence.title: Pinned Dify main revision observation
limitations: The main branch can move after this observation; all other evidence is pinned to the observed commit.
The timestamp is normalized to the observation date; the exact retrieval second was not retained.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata observation
limitations: Public visibility does not determine license compatibility.
The metadata observation can become stale.

evidence.title: Dify README at pinned revision
limitations: Feature and resource statements are upstream documentation claims, not runtime proof.

evidence.title: Dify modified license at pinned revision
limitations: The fixture records technical evidence only and is not legal advice.
A qualified human must assess the intended tenancy, branding, and distribution model.

evidence.title: Dify security policy at pinned revision
limitations: A disclosure policy does not establish that a release is secure or suitable for production.

evidence.title: Dify Docker Compose manifest at pinned revision
limitations: The manifest was inspected as text and not applied.
Services present in the manifest may be optional and do not prove default runtime behavior.

evidence.title: Dify Docker deployment guide at pinned revision
limitations: Documented deployment procedures were not executed.

hypotheses.statement: Dify is relevant enough to evaluate for visual workflows, retrieval applications, model integrations, and API access.
Dify can start and operate within the target local environment and resource budget.
The Dify license is compatible with the intended tenancy, branding, and distribution model.
The team can securely operate, observe, back up, upgrade, and recover the required Dify services.

checks.description: Confirm that all inspected upstream files resolve from the recorded immutable commit and match their recorded SHA-256 digests.
Obtain qualified review of the modified license for the exact intended use, including tenancy and frontend branding.
Run a separately authorized sandboxed local pilot and record startup, resource, integration, and teardown evidence.
Validate required services, secret handling, observability, backup, restore, upgrade, and rollback for the target environment.
Perform a separate threat-informed security assessment of the selected release and configuration.

decision.summary: conditional-pilot: Dify is relevant enough for a bounded local evaluation, but adoption and deployment remain blocked.
decision.rationale: Pinned documentation supports candidate relevance and a documented self-hosting path. It does not provide runtime, operational, security, or license-fit proof. The modified license and unexecuted operational surface require human review and a separately authorized sandboxed pilot before any adoption decision.

actions.description: Complete the license review before deciding whether the intended use is permitted.
If license review permits evaluation, run the isolated local pilot and capture a result pack.
Assess required services, secrets, observability, backup, restore, upgrade, and rollback.
Assess the selected release and configuration against the team's threat model.

atlasrepoBenchmark.statusQuo: Continue with the current application architecture while the candidate is evaluated; this fixture has no evidence about its cost or quality.

alternatives.note: Preserves current operations but is not supported or rejected by this Dify-focused evidence bundle.
Build directly on model-provider APIs; requires a separate evidence bundle and total-cost assessment.
Evaluate another workflow platform using the same constraints and benchmark before comparison.

decisionCriteria: Required workflow, retrieval, model, API, and access-control capabilities pass a hands-on pilot.
The intended use passes qualified license review.
Measured resource use fits an agreed local and hosted budget.
Secrets, network boundaries, data retention, backup, restore, upgrade, and rollback meet team requirements.
Security review produces no unresolved blocker for the selected configuration.
